question: What name is given to the gate structure when it is made in the form of a mandapa?
premises: A mandapa-shaped form is presented as an option
This form receives a specific designation
The designation is declared as shrikanta
inference: When made in the form of a mandapa, it is declared to be shrikanta.
plain_english: Or, if it is made in the form of a mandapa, that is declared to be shrikanta.
